proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.post_save_spell_outcome
proposed_widenings.justification: The ring has an automatic rider after a successful saving throw against a qualifying spell, but passive magic-item operations currently only support elapsed-time triggers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you.

proposed_widenings.name: TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics without required item resource/resetCadence
proposed_widenings.justification: The ring's deflection rider spends only the wearer's Reaction and has no charge pool or recharge cadence, so the current triggered-reaction magic-item shape would force a fake resource.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster

notes: The passive save-advantage grant fits existing atoms, and the deflection concept matches existing trigger/effect atoms, but the current magic-item surface cannot honestly encode the automatic post-save negation plus unlimited reaction deflection without widening.
